title: Draft construction: involutive E8 source reflection with eight rank-one repairs (no new kappa)
body:
This draft adds an explicit rank-eight involutive source preparation F = I - (K - 12P)R, specializing PR1862's broader family after dropping its fixed full-query logger requirement. On the two pinned PR1800 local words it replaces eight rank-eight centre children with eight rank-one target repairs: local rank masses 5590 -> 5534 and 5594 -> 5538. The source leaves encoded; all 480 dirty helpers are restored.

Prior local checks passed for four complete scalar words on all 712 input columns, added boundary frame access, and 16,384 added native-line Gaussian columns. After draft publication, the portable package replay also passed for both providers, including agreement with the separately implemented adjoint interpreter. The report is retained locally; global verification remains open. The complete scalar allowance is 217,622 real primitives per coordinate per call under the retained tariff.

**No new kappa or admitted supplier is claimed.** Full native composition, chart-dependent routing/source restoration, nine-call controller, hosting and precision/outer admission remain open. The draft remains draft while these obligations are unresolved.

Reproduce with `python3 -I -B research/involutive-source-reflection/verify.py`. Standard library, read-only by default; raw and decompressed source pins are included. The current inputs are frozen local replay artifacts, not claimed as direct Git blobs. No selected source, existing research package, or other worker's PR is changed.

Credit Ali Romman / PR1862 for the source-preparation interface and vendored checkers; mdumitrean, Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, icekylinx, Hao Yan and the retained supplier lineage. Original notices are preserved. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no independent human or Lean review. README and PROOF state exact scope, comparison and open next questions.
